arxiv-2305-07148.title: Fully quantum algorithm for mesoscale fluid simulations with application to partial differential equations
arxiv-2305-07148.creator: Sriharsha Kocherla, Zhixin Song, Fatima Ezahra Chrit, Bryan Gard, Eugene F. Dumitrescu, Alexander Alexeev, Spencer H. Bryngelson
arxiv-2305-07148.description: Abstract Abstract Fluid flow simulations marshal our most powerful computational resources. In many cases, even this is not enough. Quantum computers provide an opportunity to speed up traditional algorithms for flow simulations. We show that lattice-based mesoscale numerical methods can be executed as efficient quantum algorithms due to their statistical features.

arxiv-2512-15545.title: Unveiling nonlinearities of electromagnetically induced transparency in a THz metamaterial
arxiv-2512-15545.creator: Amit Haldar, 1 Shriganesh Prabhu, 2 and Shovon Pal 1
arxiv-2512-15545.description: Abstract Electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) in terahertz (THz) metamaterials relies on the coherent coupling between a radiative (bright) mode and a subradiant (dark) mode. Understanding the dynamic interplay between the bright and dark modes holds the key to manipulate the mutual interference and hence the transparency.

pmc-10637352.title: An exploratory study of knowledge, attitudes, and practices toward HPV associated anal cancer among Pakistani population
pmc-10637352.creator: Usman Ayub Awan, Wajiha Naeem, Aamer Ali Khattak, Tahir Mahmood, Shehrish Kamran, Suliman Khan, Xingyi Guo, Zhao Yongjing, Jianbo Liu, Abdul Nasir
pmc-10637352.description: BackgroundAnal cancer, mainly attributed to human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, is rising in prevalence among the general population in Pakistan. This study aimed to examine the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) towards anal cancer screening and HPV of the general population in Pakistan.MethodWe surveyed anal cancer KAP using social media and snowball sampling from December 2022 to May 2023.

pmc-11483297.title: Macrophages-derived high-mobility group box-1 protein induces endothelial progenitor cells pyroptosis
pmc-11483297.creator: Menghao Zeng, Guibin Liang, Fangfang Yuan, Shanshan Yan, Jie Liu, Zhihui He
pmc-11483297.description: SummaryEndothelial dysfunction is an important factor in the progress of sepsis. Endothelial progenitor cells (EPCs) are the precursor cells of endothelial cells and play a crucial role in the prognosis and treatment of sepsis. EPCs in the peripheral blood of patients with sepsis undergo pyroptosis, but the mechanism remains much of unknown.

pmc-11672578.title: Cloning and Functional Analysis of Skin Host Defense Peptides from Yakushima Tago’s Brown Frog (Rana tagoi yakushimensis) and Development of Serum Endotoxin Detection System
pmc-11672578.creator: Taichi Aono, Saki Tamura, Yua Suzuki, Taichi Imanara, Ryosei Niwa, Yoshie Yamane, Tetsuya Kobayashi, Sakae Kikuyama, Itaru Hasunuma, Shawichi Iwamuro
pmc-11672578.description: Background/Objective: Amphibian skin is a valuable source of host defense peptides (HDPs). This study aimed to identify HDPs with novel amino acid sequences from the skin of Rana tagoi yakushimensis and analyze their functions. Methods: cDNAs encoding HDP precursors were cloned and sequenced using RT-PCR and 3′-RACE.

pmc-11693926.title: Neoadjuvant Cetuximab Leading to a Complete Pathologic Response in Locally Advanced Lip Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-11693926.creator: Ruba Alchaikh Hassan, Zahra Gafarzadeh, Shiva Salmasi, David M Hyams, Constantin A Dasanu
pmc-11693926.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Vermillion lip squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) is a rare cancer, currently grouped together with the cutaneous lip under the cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) system. Herein, we present a case of an 81-year-old male with locally advanced lower lip SCC involving the vermillion who achieved a complete pathologic response to neoadjuvant cetuximab after the failure of the programed cell death protein-1 (PD-1) inhibitor, cemiplimab. He was followed with clinical observation, with special attention to skin/mucosal surfaces.

pmc-12648961.title: New insights on the cavitation development and the role of bubbles in Micro-Venturi channels☆
pmc-12648961.creator: Mohammadamin Maleki, Abhinav Priyadarshi, Jolyon Cleaves, Erçil Toyran, Ali Kosar, Iakovos Tzanakis, Morteza Ghorbani
pmc-12648961.description: Graphical abstract Introduction Hydrodynamic cavitation (HC) is a phenomenon characterized by the formation, expansion, and subsequent collapse of vapor or gas bubbles, driven by localized pressure fluctuations within a flowing liquid. This process has been extensively studied at conventional scale and has been found to deteriorate the performance of hydraulic and turbomachinery[1].

pmc-13072075.creator: Yusuph A Kafula
pmc-13072075.description: Predicted global temperature increase is expected to have unprecedented effects on freshwater ecosystems. While the individual impacts of temperature and chemical exposures on aquatic species physiology, life history and survival have received adequate attention, the interactive effects of temperature and chemical toxicity, particularly on the temporary pond ecosystems, have yet to be elucidated.

pmc-13195963.title: Viral associations in multiple sclerosis: pathogenetic mechanisms and therapeutic implications
pmc-13195963.creator: Mostafa Meshref, Ahmed Salah Hussein, Sahar Ahmed Allam, Khaled Moghib, Hossam Younis, Nevin Shalaby
pmc-13195963.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a neurological inflammatory disease with a complex etiology involving the dysregulated immune system, chronic inflammation, and genetic susceptibility. Although the precise cause of MS is unknown, previous studies have found a strong link between MS and certain viral infections, leading researchers to speculate that viruses may play a role in MS pathogenesis by acting as environmental triggers.

pmc-13287815.description: This study presents a novel surface plasmon resonance (SPR) biosensor composed of silver (Ag), bismuth ferrite (BiFeO3), nickel (Ni), and perovskite nanomaterial (MAPbBr3). Different ethanol concentrations (ECs) could be detected thanks to the hybrid structure. The transfer matrix technique (TMM) is used to assess the suggested surface plasmon resonance (SPR) structure.

pmc-13366084.title: IFPHOR0064 Waiting Well as Prevention: A Multi-Pathway Public Health Evaluation of Interventions Across Elective and Mental Health Waiting Lists
pmc-13366084.creator: Rochelle Velho, Katie Hibbitt, Ben Hollands, Jonathan Webster, Uma Walgama, Zafar Iqbal, Farah Kidy
pmc-13366084.description: BackgroundWaiting lists in England continue to rise, contributing to clinical deterioration, psychological distress and widening inequalities. Waiting periods are recognised as actionable intervals where targeted Wait List Interventions (WLIs) can mitigate harm rather than act as passive delays. This study synthesises evidence for WLIs across obesity, and adult & paediatric mental health pathways.

pmc-13562392.title: Effects of hot air drying on fatty acid and lipid profiles in golden pomfret based on UPLC-Q-TOF-MS-based lipidomics analysis
pmc-13562392.creator: Long Zheng, Huadan Zhang, Yalin Zhang, Xiaowei Pan, Haiying Wu, Saihao Ren, Shaodong Zeng, Jianzhi Ye, Huifang Ma, Baodong Zheng
pmc-13562392.description: Golden pomfret (Trachinotus ovatus) is an important mariculture fish rich in unsaturated fatty acids, while the dynamic remodeling of lipid molecules during hot-air drying remains poorly understood. To thoroughly analyze the lipid composition and dynamic changes in golden pomfret dried under different durations, fatty acid profiles and lipid compositions were identified via GC-FID and UPLC-Q-TOF-MS.
